## Does it affect any health-related result?
If yes, list the precise claim, source DOI/PMID or guideline version, population, endpoints, relevant uncertainty, and evidence ID. Explain whether the change alters wording, calculations, thresholds, diet/lab guidance, or treatment-related implications; flag unresolved evidence.

## Scientific review, privacy, and rights
- [ ] Sources, limitations, conflicting evidence and relevant corrections have been considered (or not applicable).
- [ ] No real medical/genomic records, unlicensed third-party content, tracking, or unreviewed personal clinical advice are added.
- [ ] If introducing original research prose or assets, I have the necessary rights for the repository's applicable licenses (or not applicable).
